title: Phase-gated control plane variant rollouts for Private deployments (Terraform modules + canary automation)
creator: Priya Patel
description: Goal: Implement a phase-gated canary/variant rollout mechanism for control plane upgrades in Private (VPC) deployments that is driven by Terraform modules and automated health checks. This ticket covers: 1) a versioned Terraform module pattern for control plane stacks (module-private-controlplane) that supports variant/per-canary overlays; 2) CI/CD orchestration to create targeted canary deployments and promote versions; 3) a set of automated preflight and runtime health probes used to gate promotion and trigger rollbacks; and 4) dashboards and alerting hooks in Redwood Console to observe canary performance. Deliverable must be usable by Private customers (VPC), integrate with our dedicated control-plane operator, and avoid manual scripting per-customer.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform module (module-private-controlplane) can provision two coexisting control-plane variants (stable and candidate) in the same VPC using tagged resources and minimal customer changes
CI pipeline job 'ctlplane-canary-deploy' can launch a canary rollout for a specified customer with parameters: version, canary_fraction, duration_hours, and rollback_policy

Automated gating evaluates metrics (API latency p50/p95, control-loop success rate, operator restart rate, admission-webhook error rate) and either promotes candidate -> stable or triggers automated rollback within the configured window
Canary deployment creates minimal blast radius: default canary_fraction=10% of control-plane instances (or 1 instance for small clusters) and supports traffic shadowing for full-path verification
All Terraform module changes are versioned and published with CHANGELOG, and existing private customers can opt into the candidate via a single variable toggle
Runbooks for manual override, forced rollback, and emergency safe-mode are documented and linked from the ticket
tasks: Design Terraform module interface: inputs for version, variant_labels, canary_fraction, and enable_shadowing
Implement module-private-controlplane with workspace-friendly state handling and documented migration steps
Add API compatibility preflight hooks: schema check, admission webhook dry-run, CRD version compatibility test
Extend infra CI to support a canary promotion workflow (deploy -> observe -> promote/rollback)
Create k8s-level probes and synthetic workloads for the control plane (reconcile loop smoke tests, admission request sampling)
Instrument metrics exporters and ensure Console dashboards show canary vs stable overlay
Add automated rollback: terraform apply of previous stable, plus operator-level safemode (pause rollouts)
Create end-to-end test in staging that runs the full canary flow against a cloned private deployment
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (staging): run end-to-end on staging private control plane and validate gating thresholds (ETA 2025-03-18)
Phase 1 (pilot customers): opt-in for two low-risk customers, manual approval step required after automated gating (duration 7 days)
Phase 2 (automated small canaries): enable 10% automated canaries across non-critical customers for 72h monitoring window
Phase 3 (wider rollout): increase to 50% and then full promotion after two stable cycles without regressions
Emergency step: operator safemode + immediate terraform revert promoted via CI pipeline and page on failure
technical_notes: Module should avoid changing customer-managed resources unless explicitly toggled; use separate candidate ASG/k8s-resources with shared VPC networking
State management: recommend one Terraform state per customer + substate for control-plane variants. Use remote state locking via our S3+Dynamo pattern
Compatibility: add preflight 'api-surface' comparator that queries stable and candidate control-plane APIs and checks for missing endpoints or breaking response shapes
Health checks: implement a composite gating decision using weighted metrics and configured thresholds; default weights: latency 30%, errors 40%, operator restarts 20%, reconciliation failures 10%
Observability: annotate Prometheus metrics and traces with "variant"="candidate|stable" so Console can render overlays
Rollback: support 'canary-fallback' TF plan that switches traffic and decommissions candidate resources gracefully, retaining candidate state for postmortem
